question.text: Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the meta harness improves, the code base becomes easier to change, or both?

sources.text: I have been trying so hard to work on a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness. its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on. not just the trees, but the forest. it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product. it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier. that is my true goal.
judge the final result, with earlier taste checks on UI and consequential design choices.
